C-DROPBOX-KEY-BUILD-ONLY.Summary: Use only the linker-provided Dropbox app key for go run, local builds and releases; remove the runtime environment lookup and its resolver.

Goals.Goal: Simplify Dropbox configuration to the existing package-main string variable set through -X.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep the public app key variable, existing workflow environment handoff and GoReleaser linker flags. No runtime environment override remains.
Keep unconfigured builds optional for Dropbox and preserve OAuth, credentials, database and release behavior. Do not launch the real application or publish releases.
Preserve all existing staging and user edits, run sequentially, and do not add committed test files.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No CI, OAuth, database or release-trigger changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Bootstrap passes dropboxAppKey directly to NewLinker. config.go contains the variable and semantic contract without imports, os.Getenv or the resolver helper.
README documents go run and go build with -ldflags using shell expansion of DROPBOX_APP_KEY at build time; it does not promise runtime overrides.

Current deployment, graph and verification documents reflect build-time-only configuration. Temporary probes show go run and go build inject the variable, runtime environment values do not override it, and no linker value yields empty configuration.
Build/vet, formatting and final GRACE checks pass before archiving under the existing user instruction.

Assumptions.Assumption: The user explicitly proposes removing os.Getenv because go run supports linker flags. The prior archive instruction persists.
